set.body:
Outcome

Prevent a long-lived dual implementation period.

Acceptance

- Examples, atlas workflows, and internal consumers move family by family.
- Each migration records old/new estimand equality or an explicit intentional semantic break.
- Neutral fixtures and independent oracles survive; legacy API tests do not.
- No old implementation remains after its last consumer moves.
set.title: P5.7: migrate consumers and delete each old method path as parity is established
